primer: The Progressive Corporation (NYSE: PGR) is a leading U.S. P&C insurer covering 40.532 million policies in force at an 87.9% YTD October 2026 combined ratio and 34.4% TTM ROE. Pass 1 forensics maintain COMPOUNDER_PASS quality but downgrade KPI health to PASS_WITH_WATCH after October Direct Auto CR hit 96.1%, personal auto PLE fell 9% YoY despite +18% ad spend, and Florida's statutory cap constrained 2025 profits. At $231.39 (14.44x forward P/E, 3.89x P/B), our normalized 91.8% combined-ratio Excess-Return model sets Base fair value at $242.00, yielding only 0.54:1 CMP and 1.25:1 10-week EMA reward-to-risk against a $211.78 stop. Inside a 10-distribution-day US Downtrend with illiquid options, we cleanly downgrade PGR to REJECTED (TIER_0, VALUATION) and hold 0 shares.
